steps.en: Authenticate a provider and start the local web app
steps.zh: 认证提供商，启动本地网页

steps.en: Enable the provider, open a project and submit a task in a thread
steps.zh: 启用提供商，打开项目并在会话提交任务

steps.en: Run the provider in the project's server environment
steps.zh: 在项目所属服务端环境运行提供商

steps.en: Show agent responses and workspace changes in the shared UI
steps.zh: 在统一界面显示助手响应和工作区改动

value.en: Control coding-agent work without juggling provider terminals
value.zh: 不必切换各提供商终端，即可控制编程助手工作
